name: a(n) = Sum_{d|n} d' * (-1)^(d'), where d' is the arithmetic derivative of d (A003415).
comment: Inverse Möbius transform of n' * (-1)^(n'). - _Wesley Ivan Hurt_, Mar 31 2025
link: Antti Karttunen, Table of n, a(n) for n = 1..20000
mathematica: d[1] = 0; d[n_] := n * Plus @@ ((Last[#]/First[#]) & /@ FactorInteger[n]); a[n_] := DivisorSum[n, d[#] * (-1)^d[#] &]; Array[a, 100] (* _Amiram Eldar_, May 12 2022 *)
program: a(n) = sumdiv(n, d, my(dd=ad(d)); dd*(-1)^dd); \\ _Michel Marcus_, May 13 2022
